project_title: Context-Aware Lip Reading and Speech Generation Using Deep Learning
institution: K. J. Somaiya School of Engineering, Mumbai- 77
department: Department of Electronics and Computer Engineering
program: Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) in Electronics and Computer Engineering

mentor.name: Prof. Umang Patel
mentor.designation: Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics and Computer Engineering

word_model.name: WordVideoNet
word_model.architecture: 3D-CNN (Conv3d x3 + BatchNorm3d + SiLU) + Spatial Global Pooling + 2-layer Bidirectional GRU + Linear Classifier
word_model.dataset_source: GRID Corpus (33 speakers on disk, 32,891 utterances)

splits.train: 96 samples (24 per class across 23 disjoint speakers: s1-s20, s22-s24)
splits.valid: 32 samples (8 per class across 5 disjoint speakers: s25-s29)
splits.test: 32 samples (8 per class across 5 held-out speakers: s30-s34)

word_model.visemic_homopheny: place (/p/) and bin (/b/) share bilabial lip closure; 6/8 place samples predicted as bin

video_to_text.name: Visual CTC Sequence Decoder
video_to_text.status: In Development (Fails closed; no verified trained visual-only sentence checkpoint)

technical_facts.test_suite: 32 passing tests (100% pass rate in tests/test_browser_inference.py and tests/test_word_recognition.py)
technical_facts.frontend_build: Vite v5.4.21 + React 18, 0 errors, built in 16.18s
